messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Older adults clear sertraline more slowly. In one study, plasma clearance in people aged 65 and over was about 40% lower than in adults aged 25 to 32, so it took 2 to 3 weeks to reach steady levels rather than about 1 week. Doctors usually start older adults at the low end of the dose range. Older adults are also at greater risk of low sodium levels in the blood, particularly if they take diuretics (water pills) or are dehydrated.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "has risk factor", "low sodium levels in blood"]

The relation 'has risk factor' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is associated with an increased risk of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has increased risk in': The subject drug may pose a higher risk of adverse effects in the population or group specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
E. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
